What each column measures and how to read it. Numbered ratings are comparative across the whole filament market, not within a family, and colour marks whether a high number is favourable for that property.

Prices are dated listing snapshots in USD; sale, from and regular prices are identified in the entry notes. Manufacturer claims and independent tests retain their source labels and conditions. A blank means not documented. Material summaries and dimmed inherited product values describe a family or representative grade; use the product datasheet for the exact spool. Shore A, Shore D and Rockwell are separate scales.
